nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Smart cities|Waste management|Gps-enabled waste collection routes_qna_000
nodes.question: What is the main focus of the waste collection route optimization model proposed by Hanna net al. (2020)?
nodes.answer: The main focus of the model is to link cost-saving and emission reduction in waste management to achieve sustainable development goals.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Smart cities|Waste management|Gps-enabled waste collection routes_qna_001
nodes.question: How can waste collection route optimization contribute to sustainable development goals?
nodes.answer: By optimizing waste collection routes, cost savings can be achieved, and emissions can be reduced, leading to a more sustainable waste management system.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Smart cities|Waste management|Gps-enabled waste collection routes_qna_002
nodes.question: What was the main objective of the waste collection route optimization model developed by Hanna net al. in 2020?
nodes.answer: The main objective of the waste collection route optimization model was to link cost-saving and emission reduction to achieve sustainable development goals.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Smart cities|Waste management|Gps-enabled waste collection routes_qna_003
nodes.question: How can the waste collection route optimization model by Hanna net al. contribute to sustainability efforts?
nodes.answer: The model can lead to cost savings and emission reductions, contributing to sustainable development goals.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Smart cities|Waste management|Gps-enabled waste collection routes_qna_004
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: How often did the GPS devices record locations to optimize battery life?
nodes.answer: The GPS devices recorded locations once every 2 hours to optimize battery life.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Smart cities|Waste management|Gps-enabled waste collection routes_qna_005
nodes.question: What optimization benefits were observed in solid waste collection planning by utilizing Fixed Routing Optimization and Variable Routing Optimization?
nodes.answer: By utilizing Fixed Routing Optimization and Variable Routing Optimization, considerable optimization benefits were observed in solid waste collection planning, with implications for multiple SDGs such as SDGs 7, 11, 12, and 13.
